The 8 Kootas & Ontikoppal Heritage

ಅಷ್ಟಕೂಟ 36 ಗುಣ ಮಿಲನ ಹಾಗೂ ಪಂಚಾಂಗದ ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯ ನಿಯಮಗಳು

೧. ವರ್ಣಕೂಟ (Varna) 1 Guna

Spiritual development, ego alignment, and social compatibility.

೨. ವಶ್ಯಕೂಟ (Vashya) 2 Gunas

Mutual magnetic attraction, respect, and marital harmony.

೩. ದಿನಕೂಟ (Dina/Tara) 3 Gunas

Longevity, fortune, health, and auspicious daily companionship.

೪. ಯೋನಿಕೂಟ (Yoni) 4 Gunas

Biological compatibility, physical affection, and marital bond.

೫. ಗ್ರಹಮೈತ್ರಿ (Graha Maitri) 5 Gunas

Intellectual and psychological harmony between Moon sign lords.

೬. ಗಣಕೂಟ (Gana) 6 Gunas

Temperament and behavior (Deva, Manushya, and Rakshasa).

೭. ರಾಶಿಕೂಟ (Bhakoot) 7 Gunas

Family prosperity, mutual growth, and emotional welfare.

೮. ನಾಡೀಕೂಟ (Nadi) 8 Gunas

Genetic health, offspring, nervous constitution, and vital energy.

📜 Historical Note from Ontikoppal Panchanga (ಪುಟ 90 / Book Page 88)

Established in 1887 in Mysore, Karnataka, the ಒಂಟಿಕೊಪ್ಪಲ್ ಪಂಚಾಂಗ (Ontikoppal Panchanga Mandira) is one of the most venerated astrological almanacs in South India. On page 92, the editorial committee clarifies that while raw arithmetic calculations across various panchangas can occasionally yield divergent totals, the Ontikoppal revised matrix (ಪರಿಷ್ಕೃತ ಪದಕ) incorporates the verified traditional dosha cancellations and Maha Nakshatra exemptions recognized across Karnataka.
